simple.summary: מֹאזֵן (môʼzên) means balances. First listed occurrence: Dan 5 27.

definitions.full: H3977. mozanya מאֹזַנְיָא (Baer Gi Str) noun masculine emphatic scale, balance (compare also Mandean מוזאניא Nö M 148, Egyptian Aramaic מוזנא S-C G 24, Christian-Palestinian Aramaic Schulth Lex. 5 Nö BSW 56 Jacob ZAW xxil (1902), 90 ); — Dan 5:27 (van d. H. dual emphatic מאֹזְנַיָּא , see K § 51, 1, Anm. M 33 *).
